scenes.headline: How Chimera extrapolates video to six times its training length
scenes.sub: Unbundling RoPE inside a diffusion Transformer with no positional embeddings.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cashew! Chimera is a diffusion Transformer for images and video. Trained on five-second clips, it makes thirty-second ones. Here's how.

scenes.text: RoPE does three jobs in the same rotated channels. Chimera gives each job its own module, so nothing is tied to training length.
scenes.mark: gives each job its own module
scenes.say: RoPE does three jobs in the same channels. Chimera gives each its own module, so nothing is tied to training length.

scenes.title: One stream, three mechanisms, no positions

steps.say: Text, image and video tokens share one sequence, in one order, through one stack.

steps.note: a fixed-size state per head, not a growing cache
steps.say: Three in four layers use Kimi Delta Attention: a fixed-size state per head, with a forget gate per channel.

steps.note: exact global attention, with no RoPE
steps.say: Every fourth layer is latent attention, for exact global interaction. Neither kind uses positional embeddings.

steps.note: a depthwise kernel at fixed token offsets
steps.say: And short convolutions, one kernel per modality, mix tokens at fixed offsets.
An audit of RoPE found three jobs in the same channels: picking nearby positions, fading with distance, and encoding layout.
Position selection only works at short range anyway, so a short convolution takes it over.
Recency decay becomes explicit, in the forget gate.
And layout comes from the kernel's own shape: one-dimensional for text, three-dimensional and causal in time for video.

left.title: One global width ratio
items: Tune a small proxy, scale everything by one ratio
The best learning rate drifts sixfold
left.say: Scaling laws need well-tuned models at every size. One global width ratio lets the best learning rate drift sixfold.

right.title: A ratio per parameter group
items: Each group scales by its own fan-in
The best learning rate holds across a 56x range
right.say: HeteroP gives each parameter group its own ratio, from its own fan-in, and the best learning rate holds steady.

scenes.title: FID degradation at 30 seconds
scenes.note: trained on 5-second clips, no length fine-tuning; final 5 seconds scored
scenes.say: The payoff: at six times its training length, Chimera's image quality slips six and a half percent. Two full-attention baselines slip more than fifty.

scenes.text: RoPE was doing three jobs at once. Give each its own module, and nothing is tied to training length.
scenes.mark: nothing is tied to training length

recap: Linear KDA and global MLA, 3 to 1
RoPE's three jobs, moved to three modules
HeteroP keeps tuning honest across scale
scenes.say: To recap: linear and global attention, RoPE's jobs given their own modules, and a ratio per tensor.
